run_refine_track: run refine_track to refine coarse 2D track predictions using a fine feature network and fine tracker
run_refine_track_v0: run refine_track_v0 to refine coarse 2D track predictions using a fine feature network and fine tracker without chunking
run_compute_score_fn: run compute_score_fn to compute tracking scores as standard deviation of 2D similarity heatmaps
run_extract_glimpse: run extract_glimpse to extract image patches at given offsets using bilinear grid sampling
review_refine_track: review refine_track which extracts patches around coarse predictions and refines them via fine_tracker with optional score computation
